alive.last_commit_message:
test(skiller): local lab targets and helper scripts for Skiller tests

Two vulnerable lab apps on the local pentest network, each with the
prompt the agent session is given:
- skiller_sqli_csrf: a boolean-blind SQLi behind a single-use form
  nonce (172.28.0.91), which a --batch sqlmap run misreads as not
  injectable;
- skiller_nosql_login: a MongoDB operator injection in a form-encoded
  login (172.28.0.92), with a v1 skill that only tries JSON bodies.

Helpers: skiller_job.sh (latest Skiller job state), skiller_progress.sh
and skiller_wait.sh (an agent session's progress, and waiting for it to
stop), skiller_verify_override.sh (the active skill-text override in the
agent's settings payload). Flags and keys are placeholders.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
